scenes.narration: Marriott collected 5.4 billion dollars in fees. So does it even own its hotels?
Hotel owners pay Marriott for the name, for running the hotel, and for bonuses when profits are high.
Marriott's total revenue was 26.2 billion dollars, but 19.2 billion of that is cost reimbursements from hotel owners.
Fees were about 21 percent of revenue, and net income was 2.6 billion dollars.
Other people's hotels. Marriott's fees. Follow for more.
